title: Verify mastery: Back up and restore ecosystem configuration
goal: VC-201-070 (P1) claims mastery of: Export versioned configuration, artifact references, and encrypted secret material only when explicitly included; restore to a clean dev instance verifies references and reports unavailable external resources.. Its own narrative does not claim delivery: PARTIAL: backup and restore is version-checked, has a dry run, and encrypts its sections on round-trip. Verified by `crates/susi-config/src/tests/state_backup.rs`: state_backup_dry_run_and_version_checks, state_backup_roundtrip_encrypts_sections. Residual: restoring to a clean dev instance, verifying artifact references there, and reporting unavailable external resources, are not enumerated by a n. Prove or refute it: add a nonzero test named vc_201_070_mastery_* that exercises the capability on its production path, and record exactly which part is missing when it cannot be proven. Coverage is not mastery: this closes only when the capability is verified, and a linked closed task is not evidence.
